name: Parano!a
summary:
Parano!a brings a clean, Quest-friendly VRChat chatbox controller directly into VR. The app lets you create and send custom OSC chatbox messages, use live placeholders like time, date, battery, RAM, max RAM, ping, uptime, and AFK time, and rotate between multiple saved messages automatically.
You can enable or disable individual features, choose which messages are included in rotation, create a dedicated AFK message with an AFK timer, and customize the look of the app with built-in themes or your own custom
